title.narrative: Strengthening solidarity economy networks of young women in 7 districts of El Salvador

description.narrative:
Impact: Strengthen the social and economic fabric and gender justice in excluded rural communities in seven districts in the Municipality of El Salvador.
The aim is to achieve systemic change by increasing the resilience of the young women participants, the families they represent, as well as the GAPC, CDIE, organisations, economic units and solidarity economy networks in which they participate. It is expected that the social fabric and economic resilience of rural communities in the districts will be increased, enabling them to cope with socio-political, economic and environmental stressors and contributing to more equitable relationships that help reduce discrimination and gender-based violence.
Overall objective: To promote resilience, leadership and social, digital and economic inclusion of young women and their households in rural areas in seven districts of the Municipality of El Salvador.
Outcome 1. Young women strengthen their knowledge and leadership skills with a vision of integral ecology, based on their rights, and restore their relationships with themselves, with others, with nature and with God.
Outcome 2. Promote economic resilience, financial and digital inclusion, and entrepreneurship among young women at risk of exclusion and poverty.
